Sam A.: Heads-up — Fluxly (mid-market SaaS) signed yesterday. Passing to CS + eng for onboarding. Key asks: SSO (SAML/Okta), private VPC peering in europe-west1, dedicated capacity estimate (P50 ~60ms), compliance questionnaire due in 10 days. Legal flagged an IP addendum delay — could become a renewal risk if onboarding slips. Deal doc: https://redwood.deals/fluxly (see notes).
Priya K.: Thanks Sam — I’ll own onboarding. Can someone add provisioning IP ranges and the infra contact? @Miguel S., can you pick up VPC peering and SSO setup? I’ll create the onboarding plan and invite the customer.
Miguel S.: On it. Quick Q: do they want private deployment (on‑prem) or VPC peering into GCP? Need region/cloud to size the pool.
Sam A.: GCP, europe-west1. They want VPC peering (not on‑prem). Primary contact: helen@fluxly.com. They also asked about a quantized q8k variant to lower unit cost — flag for eng perf team.
Priya K.: Creating CS-Fluxly onboarding runbook. Owners: Priya (CSM) — kickoff & enablement; Miguel — VPC/SSO; Jordan — integration & smoke tests; eng-support — escalation. I’ll invite Helen for a Tue kickoff and add milestone dates. Will also capture the compliance questionnaire items.
Jordan L.: I’ll prep a small test dataset and smoke tests. Need API keys + allowed PII scope. Sam can you share contract excerpt or redlined items we need to watch?
Sam A.: Sending contract excerpt now. Note: data processing clause has a pending change from legal — that’s the addendum holding up the IP clause.
Miguel S.: Opening internal ticket CS-4321 with initial checklist:
```
- VPC peering (GCP europe-west1)
- SAML/Okta metadata exchange
- Dedicated pool sizing (initial est. 2x high‑mem GPUs)
- Quantized model eval (q8k) + fallback plan
- Compliance questionnaire attachments
```
Assigning to @Miguel S. — aiming for initial ETA by EOD Friday. @Priya please drop test creds in the ticket and link to 1Password.
deploy-bot: New ticket created CS-4321 by Miguel S. — https://redwood.atlassian/CS-4321
Priya K.: :thumbsup: I’ll upload sample creds to 1Password folder 'fluxly-onboard' and paste the link in CS-4321. Also capturing renewal risk in the runbook (legal addendum blocking data processing). I’ll loop in Legal and Sales Ops today.
Miguel S.: We’ll propose an rdx-q8k-fallback model in the runbook if the quantized variant underperforms. Will update CS-4321 once we have the peering window and SAML metadata. Closing the loop after Legal confirms the addendum. Thanks everyone.
_post_gen_note: Generated synthetic Slack thread for customer-success handoff; matches agents.md schema: flat JSON, required metadata present, messages as single continuous string.
